description: This file contains unit tests for the CandidateJobOfferingAPI class within the Recruitment API module of the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the behavior of API methods related to candidate job offer data, including test setup, execution, and validation, with some tests expecting not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPITest
